howWeHelp.title: How We Help
howWeHelp.description: Everything you need to engage families, support residents and streamline service delivery — in one place:

keep-families-connected.title: Keep Families Connected, Reassured and Informed – Every Day
keep-families-connected.description: Give families what they want most: meaningful connection, proactive updates and peace of mind. Whether near or far, families stay closely connected to the day-to-day lives of their loved ones through real-time updates, media-rich moments and smart notification

make-every-day-count.title: Make Every Day Count with Smarter Life Enrichment Planning
make-every-day-count.description: Run engaging, person-centred life enrichment programming with far less admin. From planning to participation tracking, everything is built for speed, clarity and impact – helping your team focus more on what matters most: the people you support.

empower-every-individual.title: Empower Every Individual with Personalised Content and Routines
empower-every-individual.description: Bring learning, leisure and independence into the hands of those you support. From tailored content to structured routines, everything is designed to engage, empower and enrich daily living experiences.

unite-and-simplify.title: Unite and Simplify Team Communication and Tasks
unite-and-simplify.description: Cut through the noise with a single hub for communication, workflows and task management. Your team stays aligned, informed and focused – with less admin and more time for meaningful care.

turn-everyday-data.title: Turn Everyday Data into Actionable Insights
turn-everyday-data.description: Capture participation, feedback and outcomes in real time. With clear dashboards, instant reports and built-in surveys, you get the clarity you need to measure impact and make better decisions, faster.

seemlessly-connect.title: Seamlessly Connect with Your Care Management Systems
seemlessly-connect.description: No duplicate work, no silos. Altra integrates directly with your care management software, so data flows where it should – saving time, improving accuracy and giving your team a single source of truth.

aboutGrid.title: How Altra Supports Better Outcomes for People Supported

items.title: Promote Daily Structure and Independence
items.description: Use the Resident Content Library to deliver personalised guides that help people start their day, navigate routines, or feel more confident going out in the community — tailored to their needs and abilities.

items.title: Empower with Voice Assistants
items.description: With Voice Assistants, individuals can access their daily schedule, request support, or check what's happening in the home using simple, natural commands. It builds confidence and reduces reliance on staff for routine questions.

items.title: Support Routine Through Visual Planning
items.description: The Activities Calendar provides visibility into what's happening each day, supports planning around routines, and helps people supported build confidence in joining in. Participation can be logged and shared easily.

items.title: Keep Families Informed and Involved
items.description: Our Family Engagement module allow services to proactively share updates, moments and communication with loved ones. This reduces anxiety and helps build a shared support network around the individual.

items.title: Track What Matters
items.description: With Reporting, services can measure activity participation, engagement, and preferences — helping teams personalise support and evidence meaningful outcomes for each person.

checklist.title: Why Supported Living Providers Choose Altra

items.title: Supports Individual Goals
items.description: Content and tools can be tailored to encourage skill-building and greater autonomy.

items.title: Clear Communication
items.description: Everyone — including families — stays in the loop, improving trust and reducing confusion or duplication.

items.title: Consistency Across Teams
items.description: No matter who's on shift, teams follow the same processes and have access to the same information.

items.title: Visual and Accessible
items.description: Tools are designed to support varying abilities — with image-based content, voice control and simplified interfaces.
